records.title: GSIFN: A Graph-Structured and Interlaced-Masked Multimodal Transformer Based Fusion Network for Multimodal Sentiment Analysis
records.reason: GSIFN is a graph-structured interlaced-masked transformer fusion network for multimodal sentiment analysis with a self-supervised LSTM feature framework; a sentiment-analysis task model.

records.title: InAttention: Linear Context Scaling for Transformers
records.reason: InAttention replaces decoder self-attention so tokens attend only to initial states, making VRAM scale linearly with context length during inference and enabling long sequences on consumer GPUs.

records.title: Efficient Self-supervised Vision Pretraining with Local Masked Reconstruction
records.reason: LoMaR performs masked reconstruction inside 7x7 local windows to cut the cost of self-supervised vision pretraining (MAE/BEiT-style); a pretraining-efficiency method for vision.

records.title: MODA: MOdular Duplex Attention for Multimodal Perception, Cognition, and Emotion Understanding
records.reason: MODA is a modular duplex attention mechanism addressing cross-modal attention inconsistency in MLLMs for perception, cognition and emotion understanding; a capability architecture, not inference efficiency.

records.title: Beyond 4 bits: Data-Centric Post-training Quantization and Recovery
records.reason: Systematic study of 2-bit post-training quantization and recovery fine-tuning across model families that distills a practical recipe (vector codebook representation, task-aligned calibration mixture, codebook-only distillation) for accurate sub-4-bit LLM deployment.

records.title: LTSMiTransformer: Learnable Temporal Sparsity and Memory for Efficient Long-Term Time Series Forecasting
records.reason: LTSMiTransformer integrates learnable temporal sparse attention and a memory module for long-term time series forecasting accuracy; a forecasting task architecture.

records.title: Distributed Dynamic Associative Memory via Online Convex Optimization
records.reason: Introduces distributed dynamic associative memory and a tree-based distributed online gradient descent algorithm with static/dynamic regret bounds; online-learning theory.

records.title: A Second-Order Perspective on Pruning at Initialization and Knowledge Transfer
records.reason: Second-order investigation of why pruning pre-trained vision models at initialization on one task preserves zero-shot transfer to unseen tasks; an empirical/theoretical pruning study.

records.title: BudgetMLAgent: A Cost-Effective LLM Multi-Agent system for Automating Machine Learning Tasks
records.reason: BudgetMLAgent combines profiling, retrieval of past observations, LLM cascades and ask-the-expert calls to cut the cost of automating ML engineering tasks by 94.2%; an application-level agent cost optimization, not an inference system.

records.title: The DEformer: An Order-Agnostic Distribution Estimating Transformer
records.reason: The DEformer encodes feature identity alongside values so sequential transformers can do order-agnostic density estimation, demonstrated on binarized MNIST; a generative-modeling proof of concept.
